name: Monster Shooter
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, May 26, 2021.

----------------------------------------------
Adventure across a planet floating in space to rescue a small cat who has been kidnapped by monsters. It is a shooting game where you attack many enemies that stand in front of you.

Adopting a top-down shooter style, you can enjoy exciting action with impressive screen development and high-speed movement with 3D support.

There are a total of 60 stages divided into three planets. You can choose from ``Story Mode,'' where you fight while enjoying a journey through space, ``Survival Mode,'' where you fight for your survival, and ``Killer Mode,'' where you fight against increasingly powerful enemies.There is a wide variety of ways to enjoy the game. You can defeat hateful monsters while making full use of various weapons such as shotguns, plasma guns, grenades, and rocket launchers.
